desktop.notesZh:
批次十二（图 Tab 定序 + 测试流图手动运行/配置入口/配置文件预览 + 质量资产清单）
① 会话图 Tab 顺序固定：轨迹图/工作流图/测试流图三个图 Tab 恒定排在对与轨迹之后、其他 Tab 之前（唯一 order 11/12/13），取消显示再打开仍回到原位。② 测试流图：每个节点新增独立「运行」按钮，手动触发单阶段并展示真实退出码与输出尾；顶部新增「配置」按钮，与工作流图的配置入口一致直达设置·工作流；所有阶段指令统一 baf 封装（baf-quality test/check/lint、clang-format）；删除「执行纪律」横幅；clang-format 卡片删除「无独立报告」注记，改为「格式化路径」输入（默认 source），运行按钮对该路径执行 clang-format -i；每个步骤新增「配置文件」chips（project.yml、ceedling-config.json、CPPLINT.cfg、cppcheck-suppressions.xml、.clang-format 等，须受 git 控制），点击模态框预览真实文件内容并可一键打开。③ 质量监控：新增「质量资产」卡——把质量监控的全部资产逐行列出（Ceedling 工程配置/质量门禁配置/cpplint 规则/cppcheck 抑制列表/clang-format 排版规则/UT 工程说明/静态分析入库说明，全部受 git 控制、由一键安装写入工程目录），每行支持预览与打开；删除「测试流图·单元测试执行流程」卡；工具全部必装（不再有选装）。④ 工作流图：删除「必装工具步骤/选装工具步骤」图例与「执行纪律」横幅。
desktop.notesEn:
Batch twelve (fixed graph-tab order + test-flow manual run/config entry/config-file previews + quality assets list)
(1) Session graph tabs have a fixed order: trace/workflow/test-flow always sit right after chat and trace, before any other tab (unique orders 11/12/13); hiding and re-showing returns them to the same spot.
(2) Test-flow: every node gains an independent Run button that triggers that single stage and shows the real exit code plus output tail; a header Config button jumps to Settings > workflow exactly like the workflow graph; all stage commands are baf-wrapped (baf-quality test/check/lint, clang-format); the discipline banner is gone; the clang-format card drops the no-report note in favor of a Format path input (default source) that Run applies clang-format -i to; every step lists its config files as chips (project.yml, ceedling-config.json, CPPLINT.cfg, cppcheck-suppressions.xml, .clang-format, all git-tracked) that open a real-content preview modal with an open-in-editor action.
(3) Quality monitoring: a new Quality assets card enumerates every asset line by line (Ceedling project config / quality gate config / cpplint rules / cppcheck suppressions / clang-format rules / UT project guide / static-analysis vault guide — all git-tracked, written into the project by one-click install), each row previewable and openable; the test-flow execution card is removed; every tool is mandatory (no optional tier).
(4) Workflow graph: the mandatory/optional-tool-steps legend and the discipline banner are removed.
